name: San Felices de los Gallegos (Spain)
description: Square white flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Felices de los Gallegos (a bishop's figure on blue and a tower on white).
history: The arms of San Felices de los Gallegos were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 10 May 1997; the municipal flag was approved on 11 June 1998 and is square, plain, with the council's own arms over all.

features.role: San Felices de los Gallegos arms — bishop's figure on blue and tower on white
